install.description: Creates the account if it is missing and reconciles shell, home, groups and the SSH public key if it exists. Groups must already exist. The ssh_public_key secret slot holds an OpenSSH public key.
install.title: Install user account

uninstall.description: Removes the account and its home directory. No-op when the account does not exist.
uninstall.title: Uninstall user account

update.description: Reconciles shell, home, groups and the SSH public key to the module's state. Same behavior as install; run it after changing the profile's parameters.
update.title: Update user account

verify.description: Read-only check that the account exists with the expected shell, home and group memberships. Exits non-zero when it does not.
verify.title: Verify user account

description: Creates and reconciles a local user account with a login shell, home directory under /home, group memberships and the admin's SSH public key (key-based access; the account is created without a password). Targets Debian 12/13 and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04.
name: user
title: User account
